tools.note: The roster is the registry's, not the config's — only `main` changes.

config_read.note: The entire serde shape of AppConfig, twice. This is what the TypeScript serializer has to reproduce field for field.

config_set.note: `shore model use` wins over the file until it is reset; `masked_by_session` says so.

config_reload.name: check mode reports without applying
config_reload.note: No `prompts_refreshed` field at all in check mode — not `false`.

config_reload.name: a truthy non-boolean apply is not an apply
config_reload.note: `as_bool` on a number is `None`, so both flags fall back to false and this is check mode.

config_reload.name: apply adopts the config on disk
config_reload.note: `state_after` is the whole point: three chat models now, and `defaults_model` moved.

config_reload.name: a broken config aborts before adopting anything
config_reload.note: `state_after` still shows the original config — the failure is before any mutation.

config_reload.name: a broken character overlay aborts the reload
config_reload.note: The overlay is validated against the *fresh* global config, so a typo in one character's config.toml stops the whole reload rather than silently falling back at merge time.

  |
1 | nope = [[[
  |           ^
invalid array
expected `]`

config_reload.name: check mode lists the prompt files that differ
config_reload.note: SOUL.md differs from its snapshot and USER.md matches, so exactly one file is reported. Nothing is applied.

config_reload.name: a prompt file with no snapshot at all is changed
apply with refresh_prompts activates the pending edits
config_reload.note: `prompts_refreshed` is true only on this path. `changed_after` is what says the snapshot was actually rewritten: the same call in check mode leaves it non-empty.

config_reload.name: apply without refresh_prompts leaves the snapshot alone
config_reload.note: The mirror of the case above: same tree, same adopt, but `changed_after` still lists SOUL.md.

config_reset.name: reset drops runtime overrides and reloads from disk
config_reset.note: `defaults_stream` goes back to the file's `false`, and `active_model` back to null.

config_reset.name: reset with a broken config on disk
config_reset.note: `internal_error` here, where `config_reload` reports `invalid_request` for the same file.
